policy.purpose: Reduce repeated image-search work without replacing editorial judgment.
policy.selectionRule: Choose the source and image that best perform the editorial job. The catalog and registered sources are preferred starting points, not mandatory order.

preferredStartingPoints.purpose: Reuse an already verified, commit-pinned Pulse image when it remains specific and current.
Software, models, developer tools, logos, screenshots and architecture diagrams.
preferredStartingPoints.searchMethod: Find the official organization or project repository, then inspect README, docs, releases and media directories.

preferredStartingPoints.purpose: People, companies, locations, hardware, buildings and historical events.
preferredStartingPoints.searchMethod: Search Wikimedia Commons with exact entity terms and verify the file page and license.

preferredStartingPoints.purpose: Product launches, announcements, reports, charts and first-party evidence.
preferredStartingPoints.searchMethod: Use an official newsroom, press kit, media library, documentation site, report or paper when it provides the strongest image.

preferredStartingPoints.purpose: Research, policy, science, energy, infrastructure and public-interest context.
preferredStartingPoints.searchMethod: Use government, university, standards-body or research-institution media when relevant.

preferredStartingPoints.purpose: Credible contextual imagery when first-party or public material is unavailable or visually insufficient.
preferredStartingPoints.searchMethod: Use established technical or business publications with durable static assets and clear attribution.
